    Gabriel's covering theorem for pieces of the cover #

    If every finite set of objects of the universal cover lies in a finite convex piece (interval-finiteness), every finite convex piece is representation-finite, the fundamental group is torsion-free, and the graded-indecomposable k(P)-modules have supports of bounded size, then k(P) is representation-finite (repFin_of_bounded_support).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.pathTot_iso {k : Type u} [Field k] {D : FinQuiver} {X Y : Rep k D} (φ : X ≅ Y) (le : List D.A) :
    Y.pathTot le = Rep.Hom.tot φ.hom ∘ₗ X.pathTot le ∘ₗ Rep.Hom.tot φ.inv

    Path operators are conjugated by isomorphisms of representations.
